name: Europe hybrid attacks
summary: France pinned October store sabotage on an IRGC unit on 10 Nov; Baltic drone alerts 10–11 Nov; no new shutdowns found
state: France has attributed the 11–12 Oct attacks on refrigeration at about 700 stores to Shahid Kaveh, a unit linked to Iran's Revolutionary Guards; Iran denies it (Al Jazeera, 10 Nov). Drones entering from Russia or Belarus triggered shelter alerts across the Baltic states on 10–11 Nov (Reuters). With no casualties and no repeated multi-country shutdowns since, the Alert line is not crossed.
for_you: Flights in the Baltic region and wider Europe can face short-notice delays from airspace alerts or threats. Check with your airline and follow FCDO travel advice for the countries concerned.
rubric_hit: Watch: sabotage attributed to a state (France–IRGC, 10 Nov); no casualties or repeated cross-border shutdowns

why: Sabotage, arson and drone incursions over airports and bases are how state confrontation reaches daily life in the UK and Europe.
drivers: Russia–NATO tensions, drone and cyber capabilities, proxy recruitment, elections.

rubric.alert: Repeated airport or infrastructure shutdowns across several countries, or sabotage causing casualties or a major outage.
rubric.watch: Drone incursions close an airport or military base, or a sabotage incident is attributed to a state.
rubric.normal: No significant attributed sabotage or airspace incursions in Europe this week.
